newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine 2-year note coupon down to 12.875 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine 2-year note coupon down to 12.875 pct.

text.p: The coupon rate on the Philippines' fixed rate two-year notes fell to 12.875 percent from 13.75 percent last month, the Bureau of Treasury said on Tuesday.
A total of 6.78 billion pesos worth of bids were tendered by banks of which the auction committee accepted only 3.0 billion pesos.
The average rate was 12.823 percent, with the high at 12.875 percent and the low at 12.375 percent.
